title: GOD IS
IN THIS PLACE
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: dew drops on leaves in soft light
warm morning light through linen curtain

scenes.a: That heavy uncertainty weighing on your heart belongs in the presence of the living God.
And Jacob awaked out of his sleep, and he said, Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not.
And he was afraid, and said, How dreadful is this place! this is none other but the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven.
And Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put for his pillows, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil upon the top of it.
Lord, help me see that you are standing exactly where I am today in this struggle.
Transform my anxiety into an altar of praise and let me walk in your holy confidence.
